decision: Retain four distinct planning guides; correct access, trip logistics, source age and generalized maps. No new routes or numerical scoring thresholds.
structuralFinding: These are four separately named county water trails on Mattawoman Creek, the Lower Potomac, Nanjemoy Creek and the Port Tobacco River. Shared regional boilerplate was a quality problem; endpoint-combination duplication was not established. URL reduction is not the acceptance criterion.

sourceReview.replacementDate: 2014 second edition; the current county facility page links this edition, but that does not make the brochure current
sourceReview.visualReview: Both full brochure pages inspected, including all four maps, scale bars, access descriptions and the publication-date panel. The 2018 county Mallows paddler guide was separately reviewed; its Ghost Fleet loop is not the Purse itinerary.
sourceReview.accessMethod: Queried Charles County features with geometry in EPSG:4326. Use separate floating/soft paddle entries where named. These are published access-site anchors, not surveyed water edges. Do not promote inventory attributes to current fee, closure or opening proof.
sourceReview.imageryMethod: Visually compared generalized lines against Esri World Imagery exports, using the actual returned georeferencing extent rather than the requested bbox. Imagery is a geographic cross-check, not current access, depth, hazard or ownership evidence.
sourceReview.hydrographyLimit: USGS NHD layer 12 returned 314 waterbody features but omitted the main tidal estuaries. The area-layer query returned HTML instead of data. No complete polygon containment or land-crossing certification is claimed.

trails.changes: Use Mattingly's separate floating soft launch and Smallwood's kayak launch. Correct the park name while preserving the historical URL. State a one-way shuttle, current manager checks and the boundary before the separate open-Potomac continuation.
trails.distanceLimit: The 2014 brochure states about 4.5 miles. The generalized line is shorter and is not an independent mileage validation; do not stretch the line to force agreement.

trails.changes: Resolve the impossible three-mile/6.8-mile-straight-line conflict by correcting copied access coordinates, not increasing mileage. Mallows has road access and a separate paddle launch. Require a one-way shuttle; a return paddle is additional. The county brochure runs the reverse direction.
trails.carryLimit: The 2014 brochure says quarter-mile carry; DNR's access inventory says half-mile portage. Show the disagreement and require an actual path/beach check. Neither point is a parking pin or a claim of a surveyed wet edge.

trails.changes: Replace the misplaced launch with DNR's separate Friendship floating soft entry. Explain the brochure's approximately two-mile Church Creek and four-mile Hilltop Fork return choices, without creating extra standalone URLs. Keep the open Potomac continuation outside scope.
trails.distanceAndMapLimit: The brochure distances are old option estimates, not cumulative legs or verified measurements to a selected turnaround. The map/GPX illustrates access and the Church Creek approach only; it does not locate a two-mile turnaround or depict the Hilltop Fork option. The return follows the approach rather than an invented triangular loop through marsh.
trails.campingLimit: Older brochure and access inventory list a primitive campsite; current county permission and reservations must be confirmed.

trails.marinaCoordinateSource: 2014 brochure DMS 38°29'49.29 N, 77°1'34.86 W; facility-area anchor, not an agreed kayak landing
trails.changes: Correct the private-marina anchor, require explicit take-out permission and a one-way shuttle. Explain the reverse direction from the county brochure and separate Goose Bay options. Surface DNR's May 4, 2026 credit-card gate and pass-holder entry-code notice.
trails.currentSourceLimits: The current marina owner website confirms the business and address, not public kayak landing rights. Remove the unverified marina campground claim; older Chapel Point camping needs current county confirmation. Current manager notices override the old GIS fee/gate fields.

invariants: Four public planning trips retained; no invented gauge cutoff or same-day score.
Keep USGS 01658000 upstream Mattawoman context and USGS 01660795 regional Potomac context on their existing trips.
Protect unrelated records, route assets, access providers and registry entries; refresh only affected geometry features.
Published source mileage is not a certified GPS-track length. Map and GPX qualifications must remain visible.
This batch does not establish Google ranking or traffic recovery.
publication: Pending local verification, merge and deployment; working-copy changes are not live recovery evidence.

localValidation.sameLaunchFix: Closed traces retain their full return when source endpoints differ only by six-decimal asset rounding; distinct requested endpoints still use ordinary clipping.
